pendingApproval: This version was sent for approval. It gets its number and can go to the customer once an approver decides.

create.title: Create quotation from BOQ
create.hint: The categories and items of the BOQ are priced for you; then adjust profit, discount and terms. Empty fields use the project's defaults.

fields.title: Quotation title
fields.titlePlaceholder: Leave empty to use the project name
fields.boqCurrent: Current BOQ (saved as a new version)

empty.title: This project has no quotation yet
empty.hint: Create one from the BOQ in one click, then adjust profit and terms before it gets a number.

totals.title: Totals
totals.notVatRegistered: The company is not VAT registered, so no VAT is charged.

pricing.notVatRegistered: The company is not VAT registered (change it in the company profile), so the quotation charges no VAT.
pricing.ratesHint: Used for categories you add. Selling price = cost x (1 + markup + overhead + profit).
pricing.noDiscountGovernment: A government quotation has no discount or rounding.
pricing.noDiscountPerCategory: VAT per category cannot be combined with a discount or rounding.
pricing.partsHint: Each part is priced as total cost x Factor F (VAT included). Every category in the price must belong to exactly one part.

payment.title: Payment terms
payment.hint: Instalments as a percent of the value; they must add up to 100% (leave empty to bill by progress).
payment.progressAt: Progress at which it falls due

problems.title: Fix these before the changes can be saved
problems.pricing: This pricing is not allowed; your changes are not saved yet.
problems.payment_terms_total: The payment instalments must add up to 100%.
problems.payment_terms_label: Every instalment needs a Thai and an English name.
problems.dates_order: The valid-until date cannot be before the issue date.

issue.title: Issue the quotation
issue.hint: Once issued it gets its number and this version can no longer be edited (start a new version instead). With an approval policy it waits for an approver first.
issue.pending: Sent for approval, waiting for an approver

response.title: Record the customer's answer
response.hint: Use it when the customer answered outside the link, for example by phone, e-mail or a signed copy.
response.name: Answered by

responseBanner.accepted: The customer accepted this quotation, by {name}
responseBanner.change_requested: The customer asked for changes, by {name}
responseBanner.rejected: The customer rejected this quotation, by {name}

newVersion.fromBoq: New version from the latest BOQ

compare.title: Compare versions
compare.needMore: At least two versions are needed to compare.
compare.pickDifferent: Pick two different versions to compare.
